calls.summary:
# Jeff & Ryan
Date: 2026-09-23 | Duration: 34m

## Summary
The team reviewed improvements to SDR activity tracking, CRM management, forecasting, and sales planning. LinkedIn and Apollo activity is being integrated into HubSpot through Clay and Zapier, with Clay enriching about 90% of prospects with business emails. Deals are created at meeting set, move to discovery only after a completed and accepted meeting, and are disqualified when unqualified or no-show; recent checks found no past-due meeting-set deals. Forecasting is moving toward scenario-based planning, with the current forecast around $1.9M and upside to $2.1M, while September added $2.8M across 31 deals. A 15–20 minute AE order-form training, recording, and office hours are planned. The team also discussed merging Rev Ops and Growth Ops boards, reinstating forecast calls, reviewing funnel conversion, and beginning territory and capacity planning. Jeff may shift from technical support toward strategic cadence and planning.

## Keywords
Rev Ops Sprint, Clay, SDR reporting, HubSpot order form, sales funnel process, pipeline review

Send Ryan the latest Rev Ops Sprint board draft and Growth Ops merged content for review and consolidation (01:04)
Update HubSpot with the required order form fields today to ensure data accuracy and compliance (03:42)

Work with Jake to combine Apollo email and LinkedIn outreach sequences and ensure integration with Clay and HubSpot for enriched data syncing (07:01)

Support pipeline analysis focusing on larger deals that require executive briefing and customer references for closing (15:08)
Prepare to discuss prioritization of operational tasks and strategic support areas such as sales capacity and territory modeling with Ryan in upcoming meetings (23:08)
